_doc: Swappable scene for illusion_diamond (scope.md 2026-10-04): what hides inside the stone and what is behind it. Edit, then rerun: ~/onetrainer-gpu/.venv/bin/python tools/diamond_design.py shaders/illusion_diamond.mp

walls._doc: vertical internal cracks from the centre line (object y axis) outwards, at these angles (deg, in the xz plane); seen from the top they split the stone into chambers

_stars_v1: the first build's two stars + three cracks + focus mirrors are kept in scene_stars_v1.json

portals._doc: facets that open onto the star room for views leaving the stone from inside (cheat #4); axes 'cube' = the facets facing +-x/+-y/+-z; gate on the number of internal bounces

star_room._doc: procedural star in space, the SAME window behind every portal (user): dir is in each portal's own frame, z = straight out of the portal facet; radius_deg = the star's angular radius; color = photosphere tint

portal_view._doc: what the portal windows show: 'image' = a picture at 'dist' behind each portal, 'size' wide (world units; the stone is ~1.8 across) -> real parallax across a facet; 'star' = the procedural star (star_room)
